spells.name: Living Shadow
spells.description: Passive: Zed gains Energy whenever he and his Shadows strike an enemy with the same Ability. Active: Zed's Shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for seconds. Recasting this Ability will cause Zed to switch positions with this Shadow.
spells.coverageNote: This cast has no damage-calculation effect in the current one-on-one scope.

spells.name: Shadow Slash
spells.description: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. Each enemy champion hit by Zed's slash reduces Living Shadow's Cooldown by seconds. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are Slowed by % for seconds. Enemies hit by multiple slashes take no additional damage but are Slowed by % instead.

spells.name: Death Mark
spells.description: Zed becomes Untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After seconds, the mark triggers, dealing physical damage and repeating % of all damage dealt to the target by Zed while the mark was active. The dash leaves a Shadow behind for seconds. Zed can Recast this Ability to switch positions with this Shadow.
